data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 湘南街角·大衣与私服漫步
data.description: 【樱岛麻衣 · 城市夜景钟楼】璀璨灯火映亮了繁华都市的钟楼广场，站在巨大时钟前的国民女演员拉低了帽檐，在璀璨夜色次回眸浅笑。她向你伸出一只手，眼里盛满了温柔的星光——「趁着没有被狗仔和粉丝认出来，今天最后的约会时间……可要抓紧牵好我的手哦。」
data.action: 站在钟楼前，一手轻压贝雷帽檐，另一手伸向同行者
data.lighting: 街边复古路灯暖光与商店橱窗霓虹交相辉映，散景光斑梦幻
data.camera: medium full shot, shallow depth of field, city bokeh lights
data.promptProse: At the illuminated clock-tower square, Mai stands beneath the large clock face and reaches one hand toward the viewer. Her other hand touches the low brim of her beret as she gives a warm, discreet smile. A beige trench coat, plaid muffler and dark trousers make the winter outfit explicit. Street lamps and nearby shop windows light her black hair against the night, with the clock structure recognizable behind her. Frame both distinct hand actions and the stationary meeting place together. No readable clock lettering or signs.
